{{se inspekte/en}}The following statistics is extracted from the official gismu list, which contains 1436 gismu (root words) total.

See also [[Usage of rafsi space]].

For example, "v" occurs as the second letter in two gismu: "zvati" and "dzipo".  The letter "o" is generally rare in gismu.  It occurs as third letter in 17 gismu only, 5 of which is the "broda"-series.
